title: The Dog and the Hare
summary: A hound chased a hare, alternately biting her flank and then licking her face affectionately....
full_text:
A hound chased a hare, alternately biting her flank and then licking her face affectionately.

The bewildered hare cried: "I pray you, show your true colors! If you are a friend, why do you bite me? And if you are an enemy, why do you lick my face?"
moral: Be an open enemy or a true friend; do not bite and lick with the same breath.
